items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: I heard the same thing about Benny Goodman too.

ctx.x: There’s really a little bit of a negative story on that thing, it’s a joke, but this guy calls after Buddy had passed he called Buddy’s number and gets his wife or somebody, his daughter, answers the phone. And he says, “Is Buddy Rich there please?” Big lull you know. “Well Buddy passed on.” He says, “Oh, okay, I just wanted to make sure.”
I heard the same thing about Benny Goodman too.
Well sure, that’s a whole hour program, Benny Goodman.
